annotations.title: Schema / field mapping for data integration

description: Schema / field mapping for data integration — Map fields from a source schema to a target schema (CSV import, CRM migration, API integration). For each target field: source field(s), transform (direct, concat, split, cast, format_date, normalize_phone, lookup, derive...), a one-line instruction and confidence. Field names are validated offline and invented names removed; returns coverage, unmapped targets, unused sources and low-confidence rows. Params: source= and target= (comma-separated field names, optionally name:sample), optional context=. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_schema_map
